purpose: Predeclared engineering checks for observed-region reconstruction; not a claim of whole-town or formal external certification
ground_truth_policy: Evaluation and reference generation only; never estimator, tracker, mapper, tuning input, or training
scope: Only the traversed and observed region, with rolling versus accumulated geometry reported separately
alignment: First recorded ego-pose placement is primary; post-hoc rigid alignment is separate and cannot replace it
legacy_metrics: Preserve historical NPC-only protocol results and report any expanded visibility/label protocol separately
long_run: Hours-long driving requires successful short checks and global drift/loop-closure work; accumulated storage alone does not correct trajectory drift
